source.source_package: Halo Online Map Pack For Halo 3

views.finding: Central arch is the intended window, correcting earlier outside-frame interpretation. Distant dark surface does not resolve grid sufficiently for acceptance.
Foreground terrain is textured and lit. Water surface visible with strong bright reflection obscuring detail. Splash behavior remains unverified.
Closer view clearly resolves dark recessed window grid and surrounding trim in central arch. Focused static appearance confirmed; moving parallax not tested.

status: Private candidate; no production recipe promotion, installation or push.
limitations: Static views do not prove animation, parallax motion, audio, traversal, Forge, performance, console or System Link.
Full rebuild remains gated by flare-layout decision.
next_steps: Compare water reflection against matched baseline and inspect splash closely.
Implement corrugated material preserving native external fourth-color route; verify actual BSP color value.
Promote corrected profiles when their required checks pass; preserve flare rebuild gate.
